newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sasol takes stake in U.S. chemical group.
newsitem.headline: Sasol takes stake in U.S. chemical group.

text.p: SMX, the mining explosives division of Sasol Ltd, has taken an equity stake in U.S.-based DHB Holdings Inc, the two groups said in a statement on Tuesday.
A Sasol spokeswoman said it was not Sasol's policy to reveal the rand values of such takeovers but that it was "a further step towards globalisation".
The statement said that under the agreement, SMX's new explosives, based on porus prilled ammonium nitrate, would be introduced into the North American explosives market.

"This innovative product has been proven in the South African mining markets and has demonstrated its benefits through reduced explosives costs, improved blast performance, reduced levels of fumes and better control of overbreak," the statement said.
The DHB group of companies includes Viking Explosives & Supply Inc and Continental Nitrogen & Resources Corporation.
